metadata.title: 10 Minute Vegan - Strawberry Sorbet
metadata.description:
From: http://10mv.tv/QP7my6

A great treat for summertime, or any time!

For this recipe, you will need:
2 Cups Frozen Strawberries
2/3 Cup Sugar
1/4 Cup Lemon Juice

The video shows a man making a simple fruit smoothie. The man stands at a kitchen counter wearing a red t-shirt and khaki shorts. A blender is sitting on the kitchen counter next to a stainless bowl with a strainer on it. A measuring cup of white sugar and a red measuring cup of red cherries. A bottle of lemon juice is sitting next to the measuring cups. The man pours the white sugar and cherries into the pot of hot water. He then adds ice to the pot. The man stirs the pot with a wooden spatula. He then pours a cup of cherry water over the ice, shakes it, and pours it through the strainer into a stainless bowl. He repeats this two more times. The man then blends the resulting cherries and sugar in a blender. He then pours the smoothie into a glass, through the strainer into the stainless bowl, and through the strainer into the bowl with the cherries. Finally, the man picks up the bowl with the cherries. The final shot is a shot of the bald man in a white shirt.
The shot is an ad for the man's website and a vegan website, showing all three websites on a black screen at the end.
The man is standing in a kitchen in front of a counter. There is a refrigerator behind the man and a microwave to the right. There is a black countertop behind the man and a stove to the left. A window is in the background next to the refrigerator.

summary.brief: The host prepares strawberry sorbet by making a simple sugar‑water syrup, cooling it, blending it with frozen strawberries and lemon juice, freezing the mixture, and serving the finished sorbet.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the male host wearing a red t‑shirt at a kitchen counter. He combines water and sugar in a saucepan, heats it on a gas burner and stirs until the sugar dissolves. While the syrup is still hot, he pours it into a small metal bowl that is set inside a larger bowl filled with ice, chilling the syrup quickly. After the syrup is cool enough to touch, he adds lemon juice and pours the syrup over a bowl of frozen strawberries, stirring just enough to mix. He then transfers the strawberry‑syrup mixture to a blender, pulses and blends until smooth. The blended sorbet is poured into a metal bowl and placed in the freezer to set. Once firm, the sorbet is scooped into a glass (passing through a strainer) and presented in the bowl with the berries. The segment ends with a close‑up of the host, now in a white shirt, delivering a brief spoken sign‑off while social‑media and website graphics appear on a black screen.

action.detailed: Heat water and sugar to dissolve, chill the syrup in an ice bath, combine it with frozen strawberries and lemon juice, blend until smooth, freeze the mixture until set, then serve the sorbet.
action.actor: the male host, wearing a red t‑shirt (later a white shirt), standing at the kitchen counter

summary.brief: A man prepares strawberry sorbet by making a thin syrup, mixing it with frozen strawberries and lemon juice, blending the mixture, and freezing it.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the host standing at a kitchen island, introducing the strawberry sorbet recipe and listing the ingredients – frozen strawberries, sugar and lemon juice. He combines a cup of water and two‑thirds of a cup of sugar in a gray saucepan on a medium‑high burner and stirs until the sugar fully dissolves into a thin syrup. While the syrup heats, he creates an ice‑water bath by placing a smaller stainless bowl inside a larger bowl filled with ice and pours the hot syrup into the inner bowl to chill it quickly. When the syrup is cool enough to touch, he stirs in the lemon juice. He then pours the cooled syrup over the frozen strawberries in a bowl, covering the berries about halfway, and checks the texture. The strawberries and syrup are transferred to a blender, where he pulses and blends until the mixture is smooth but still slightly textured. The blended sorbet is poured into a metal bowl, placed in the freezer to set, and later the finished, frozen sorbet is shown ready to serve.

action.detailed: Heat water and sugar to make a thin syrup, chill it in an ice bath, mix it with frozen strawberries and lemon juice, blend until smooth, then transfer to a bowl and freeze.
